item.title: Cervical Cancer Screening Disparities in U.S. Immigrants
item.description: Cervical cancer screening disparities persist for African-immigrant women in the United States, highlighting barriers and care-gaps. The post Cervical Cancer Screening Disparities in U.S. Immigrants appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: 12-Week Exercise Programme Improves Patient Outcomes in Liver Disease
item.description: Since high levels of alanine aminotransferase are a significant biomarker of liver injury, this analysis points to the benefits of resistance exercise in patients with MASLD, which led to a noticeable decline in alanine aminotransferase levels. The post 12-Week Exercise Programme Improves Patient Outcomes in Liver Disease appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Imaging Uncovers Leg-Predominant Large Vessel Vasculitis
item.description: Large vessel vasculitis may present as leg pain, and FDG-PET/CT uncovered lower extremity predominant disease in 16 patients today. The post Imaging Uncovers Leg-Predominant Large Vessel Vasculitis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Norovirus Cases Reach UK Winter High
item.description: A renewed norovirus surge is pushing hospital cases to their highest level this winter, adding strain to the NHS as winter pressures persist. The post Norovirus Cases Reach UK Winter High appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Scientists Develop Water Jet for Precise Surgery
item.description: A new water jet surgical device combines cutting and anaesthesia, reducing tissue injury and allowing precise drug delivery. The post Scientists Develop Water Jet for Precise Surgery appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: More Than One in Three Say Social Media Harms Their Mental Health
item.description: More than one in three UK adults say social media has negatively affected their mental health, amid a government scramble to tighten restrictions for children. The post More Than One in Three Say Social Media Harms Their Mental Health appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: How well do you know pharma marketing?
item.description: Explore 200 years of pharmaceutical marketing in this quick quiz, from early medical advertising to today. The post How well do you know pharma marketing? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI ECG Model Predicts Cardiac Arrest Early
item.description: Deep learning models, particularly a Convolutional Neural Network, demonstrated superior performance, achieving an accuracy of 99.89% in predicting cardiac arrest. The post AI ECG Model Predicts Cardiac Arrest Early appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: EU targets 11% clinical trial growth to reclaim R&D lead
item.description: Meeting new EU targets for clinical trials could grant 35,000 additional patients access to novel treatments according to a new report. The post EU targets 11% clinical trial growth to reclaim R&D lead appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Comorbidity Burden Shapes ILD Risk in Rheumatoid Arthritis
item.description: A UK retrospective analysis finds that baseline lung comorbidities, measured using a rheumatic disease–specific index, are linked to interstitial lung disease risk in rheumatoid arthritis. The post Comorbidity Burden Shapes ILD Risk in Rheumatoid Arthritis appeared first on European Medical Journal.
